name: 3C 124 (Hubble)
blurb: 3C 124, a distant radio galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: 3c124-hubble
story: A galaxy blazing with one of the most powerful radio-loud active nuclei of its era, likely a forerunner of today's most massive elliptical galaxies. Hubble looked here to catch its stars forming and to map the cluster neighborhood around it.

claims.text: 3C124 is a radio galaxy targeted by Hubble program 16281 (redshift 1.083)
The program's 3CR sources are among the most powerful radio-loud AGNs at such redshifts, hosted by progenitors of the most massive ellipticals
The program studies the star formation and cluster environments of these systems
